correctness.rationale: All 2^12-1=4095 nonempty masks are checked via exact induced graph connectivity. There are 863 nonempty simplices, and the deterministic 428-pair element matching leaves exactly one 0-cell, three 3-cells and three 4-cells. Every one of 3432 oriented face-poset covers is included in a successful acyclicity topological sort. Independent exact signed gradient-path reductions for the three critical 4-cells yield a zero 3x3 integral Morse boundary. Forman discrete Morse gives a homotopy-equivalent CW complex, its 3-skeleton is a wedge of three 3-spheres, and pi_3 of this wedge equals Z^3, so zero boundary entries mean all 4-cell attachments are nullhomotopic. A separately constructed forbidden-triple enumeration and mod-two reduction checks face counts and Betti numbers, but does not replace the integral attaching proof. Scripts and outputs are included.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact integral homotopy classification of a canonical 12-vertex Archimedean polyhedral graph under the natural higher-independence invariant first studied in the cited P3-devoid literature. It exhibits homology in two adjacent dimensions and requires a signed attaching-map calculation, beyond a routine f-vector or known table. Its relation to graph truncation and the first nonchordal/polyhedral cases supplies a credible precise benchmark for broader higher-independence investigations, without claiming a general theorem.
